# Atanas Atanasov

> Personal website, portfolio, resume and blog of Atanas Atanasov (GitHub: `scriptex`), a Frontend Team Lead and Senior JavaScript/TypeScript engineer based in Varna, Bulgaria, building for the web professionally since 2011. He is currently Lead Frontend Developer at dmarcian, working on email authentication products (DMARC, SPF, DKIM, BIMI). He also maintains many open-source packages on npm.

Key facts:

- **Name:** Atanas Atanasov. Online handle: `scriptex` (GitHub, GitLab, LinkedIn, npm).
- **Role:** Frontend Team Lead / Lead Frontend Developer and Senior JavaScript/TypeScript engineer. Mainly front-end, but also works with back-end tools (Node.js, Python/Django, PHP, Bash).
- **Location:** Varna, Bulgaria (Black Sea coast). Works remotely with international teams.
- **Current position:** Lead Frontend Developer at [dmarcian](https://dmarcian.com) (since January 2024). Owns the front-end architecture of dmarcian's products, including moving the UI from Django server-side rendering to client-side React, migrating Vue components to React, and the front-end test automation strategy.
- **Own company:** Founded *Atanas Atanasov Consultancy* in January 2024.
- **Main skills:** TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, React Native, Next.js, Vue, Angular, Node.js, HTML, CSS/SCSS/PostCSS, SVG, MJML (email), D3/Highcharts/Chart.js data visualization, Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Testing Library, Webpack/Rollup/Vite/Parcel, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps), accessibility (a11y), internationalization (i18n).
- **Talent networks:** Toptal (top 3%), founding talent member at Braintrust, Andela, plus freelance profiles on Upwork and others.
- **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Marketing (2007) and Master's degree in Sales Management (2008), University of Economics – Varna.
- **Contact:** hi@atanas.info, or the contact form on any page of https://atanas.info. He is open to freelance and contract work.

Career history (most recent first):

1. **dmarcian**, Lead Frontend Developer (contract, remote), Jan 2024 – present. TypeScript, SCSS, SVG, React, Vue, Django, TDD, Cypress.
2. **E.ON (E.ON Home project)**, Frontend Team Lead (contract, remote), Jul 2018 – Dec 2023. Led the front-end of E.ON Home, an award-winning smart energy management web and React Native app, and its admin app (E.ON H.E.M.S., Angular).
3. **Kinetik Automotive**, Senior Web, Mobile and Desktop Applications Developer (part-time), Nov 2019 – Dec 2023. Built dashboards for electric karts, a hybrid Volvo P1800 and an electric motorcycle, plus a cloud telemetry system (React, Electron, WebSockets, Azure).
4. **Three 11 (3-11)**, Senior Software Developer and mentor, Jan 2018 – Dec 2023. Led teams building enterprise apps for clients including Kinetik Automotive, Duke University and E.ON.
5. **2create** (htmlBurger, htmlBoutique, Mail Bakery), Senior Frontend Developer, May 2012 – Jan 2018. Co-authored the company's coding standards and *Jarvis*, the internal front-end build tool, used in tens of thousands of client projects. Mentored junior developers.
6. **HTML Lab**, freelance front-end developer, 2011.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio overview](https://atanas.info/portfolio): Entry point to all portfolio categories.

- [Mobile applications](https://atanas.info/portfolio/mobile-applications): E.ON Home and Foton Home for iOS, iPadOS and Android (React Native), plus personal apps Notabene and Evolution (Ionic).

- [Email templates](https://atanas.info/portfolio/email-templates): Responsive HTML email templates (MJML).
- [Personal projects](https://atanas.info/portfolio/personal-projects): Side projects, games and utilities.

## Blog

Original articles by Atanas Atanasov, marked "Written by a Human Being". The Markdown source of each post is linked after its description.

- [Data-Driven Fat Loss: Debugging a 12-Year-Old Legacy System](https://atanas.info/blog/data-driven-fat-loss): Treating personal fat loss as a data problem: smart scale, Apple Health, MyFitnessPal and AI-assisted analysis. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/data-driven-fat-loss.md))
- [CityJS, Athens, May 28–31 2025](https://atanas.info/blog/cityjs-athens-2025): Conference report covering talks on testing, web performance and AI. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/cityjs-athens-2025.md))
- [Comparing DNS Records: DMARC, SPF, and DKIM Differences](https://atanas.info/blog/comparing-dns-records): Using `jsdiff` and record-aware algorithms to detect meaningful changes in email-authentication DNS records. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/comparing-dns-records.md))
- [The last JSConf in Budapest](https://atanas.info/blog/the-last-jsconf-in-budapest): Report from the final JSConf Budapest (June 2024), with summaries of every talk. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/the-last-jsconf-in-budapest.md))
- [Polymorphic button component for Next.js](https://atanas.info/blog/polymorphic-button-for-nextjs): One reusable React `Button` that renders as `<button>`, router `<Link>` or `<a>`. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/polymorphic-button-for-nextjs.md))
- [Testing WebSockets with Cypress](https://atanas.info/blog/testing-websockets-with-cypress): Working around Cypress dropping WebSocket sub-protocols so authenticated WebSocket connections can be tested end-to-end. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/testing-websockets-with-cypress.md))
- [Running multiple Webpack based applications simultaneously](https://atanas.info/blog/running-multiple-webpack-based-applications-simultaneously): Running several Webpack apps and an assets server in parallel for a white-label front-end. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/running-multiple-webpack-based-applications-simultaneously.md))
- [Bulk image watermark with Node.js and Jimp](https://atanas.info/blog/bulk-image-watermark-with-nodejs-and-jimp): A Node.js script that watermarks every image in a WordPress uploads folder. ([Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scriptex/atanas.info/master/src/data/posts/bulk-image-watermark-with-nodejs-and-jimp.md))

## Notable open-source projects

Most are published on npm. Each link goes to a page with the project's full README.

- [universal-github-client](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/universal-github-client): GitHub API client for the browser and Node.js.
- [lastfm-ts-api](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/lastfm-ts-api): Last.fm API client written in TypeScript.
- [create-pwa](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/create-pwa): CLI to turn a web app into a Progressive Web App (manifest, icons, splash screens, service worker).
- [react-round-carousel](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/react-round-carousel): Infinitely scrollable 3D carousel component for React.
- [round-carousel-component](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/round-carousel-component): Framework-agnostic web-component version of the 3D carousel.
- [react-svg-donuts](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/react-svg-donuts): React component for simple and complex SVG donut charts.
- [react-accordion-ts](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/react-accordion-ts): Accessible accordion widget for React, written in TypeScript.
- [react-dropper](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/react-dropper): Pick a color from any image in React.
- [touchsweep](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/touchsweep): Tiny vanilla JS library that detects swipe direction and fires custom events.
- [svg64](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/svg64): Convert SVG to base64 anywhere.
- [svgo-bimi](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/svgo-bimi): CLI tool and SVGO plugin that optimizes and validates SVG logos for BIMI (Brand Indicators for Message Identification) compliance.
- [svgo-add-viewbox](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/svgo-add-viewbox): SVGO plugin that adds `viewBox` based on `width`/`height`.
- [svg-symbol-sprite](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/svg-symbol-sprite): Build an SVG symbol sprite from a folder of SVG files.
- [attr-i18n](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/attr-i18n): Translate vanilla websites using HTML attributes.
- [dator](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/dator): Front-end form validator based on HTML5 attributes.
- [html-head-component](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/html-head-component): Native web component for everything that goes in the document `<head>`.
- [calendar-widget](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/calendar-widget): Accessible, internationalized calendar widget in TypeScript and SCSS.
- [async-array-prototype](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/async-array-prototype): Asynchronous versions of most JavaScript array methods.
- [ts-helpers](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/ts-helpers): Collection of TypeScript utilities and helpers.
- [typed-usa-states](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/typed-usa-states): Geographic data for all US states with full TypeScript types.
- [pass-score](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/pass-score): Score a password's strength as a number.
- [ga-beacon](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/ga-beacon): Use Google Analytics where it normally isn't possible (e.g. GitHub READMEs).
- [gitlab-calendar](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/gitlab-calendar): Embed your GitLab contributions calendar anywhere.
- [github-insights](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/github-insights): Insights for your GitHub repositories.
- [npm-maintainer](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/npm-maintainer): Download statistics for an npm user.
- [itcss](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/itcss): Starter boilerplate based on the ITCSS (Inverted Triangle CSS) methodology.
- [scss-goodies](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/scss-goodies): Everyday SCSS helpers and tools.
- [webpack-mpa](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/webpack-mpa): Opinionated multi-page app setup with Webpack (also [TypeScript](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/webpack-mpa-ts) and [next](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/webpack-mpa-next) variants).
- [vite-boilerplate](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/vite-boilerplate): Starter template for websites and web apps with Vite.
- [written-by-a-human-being](https://atanas.info/portfolio/open-source/written-by-a-human-being): Badge that marks content as written by a human ("Don't let AI claim your work!").

## About this website

The site is open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/scriptex/atanas.info

- **Stack:** Next.js (Pages Router), React, TypeScript, PostCSS, ITCSS, CSS Houdini, D3, BabylonJS, MDX/Markdown.
- **Data:** Contentful (CMS), MongoDB (cached GitHub, GitLab and npm insights), Redis, Cloudinary (images).
- **Hosting and tooling:** Vercel; installable PWA with offline support; ESLint, Stylelint, Prettier, Jest; scheduled GitHub Actions refresh the stats data.
